Context: mid-market marketplace search vendor. Product team (VP Product + ML lead) exploring adding a learned reranker to supplement current Elastic BM25 + business rules. Interested in Redwood hosted API for fast iteration, then Dedicated capacity for steady-state. Requirements / ask from call: p90 latency target ~120ms for rerank-only endpoint (document + query -> score), peak throughput target 200-500 QPS with bursts up to 1k for flash sales. Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML for console access, audit logs retained 13 months, KMS integration for key management. Data residency: US-only for now.

Quote: "We need consistent relevance gains without blowing up costs — can't justify full generative for every query." — VP Product.

Notes tone: fragmented; multiple internal stakeholders (engineering, infra, legal). They are pragmatic — want measurable offline evals before live canary.
